messages:
Aisha (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the shape for the chat completions surface. proposal: messages-first API ([{role, content, name?}]) but keep a top-level `prompt` compat shim. thoughts on roles, system semantics, function-calling interplay, and launch criteria?
Tom (Eng): messages-first ✅. role enum: system|user|assistant|tool. keep `system` as a single top-level message by default, but allow multiple system messages as array for advanced flows.
Nadia (ML): agree on role enum. for function-calling, we should avoid stuffing tool outputs into free-form assistant text. prefer: tool results appended as a `tool` role message plus a structured `tool_response` field when callers request structured output.
Ethan (CSE): customer ask: enterprise buyers want an immutable "system" guarantee + audit trail and a migration path. they also asked for a deprecation timeline if we change shapes.
Jules (DevEx): ergonomics note: SDKs should accept both `messages` and `prompt` and normalize. add a small helper that converts prompt->messages with a single system message when present. also allow `assistant: {content, content_type}` hint for structured outputs (json/xml).
Tom (Eng): implementation note: backend will route message role to runtime kernels; `tool` role must be explicit so we can bypass LM tokenization in some runtimes. conversion shim easy: server-side preprocessor.
Nadia (ML): edge-case: multi-system messages + function-calling race — we need a deterministic ordering rule. propose: all system messages are prepended in order received, then user, then assistant/tool. document it.
Aisha (PM): launch checklist (draft): 1) accept native messages shape, 2) prompt compatibility shim, 3) role enum + docs, 4) function-calling contract (tool role + optional structured tool_response), 5) migration script + CLI, 6) 3 enterprise EAs onboarded, 7) integration tests + eval suite, 8) telemetry for role usage.
Ethan (CSE): +1 for migration CLI. customers will want a one-command conversion + changelog. ask sales to prepare comms and a 6-month deprecation window for `prompt` if we eventually move it off.
Jules (DevEx): recommend example matrix in docs: simple chat, tools-only assistant, structured-output call, and legacy prompt->messages. include SDK snippets in JS/Py.
Tom (Eng): timeline: MVP server-side shim + docs in 6w, canary on hosted in week 8, Dedicated/private rollout by week 12 pending compliance checks.
Nadia (ML): I'll add unit tests for function call edge-cases and a small eval to detect regressions in role handling. need a few example prompts from customers to validate.
Aisha (PM): prioritization: block on legal/compliance for immutable system + audit logs (E), then dev: shim + doc (P0), SDK helpers (P1), structured tool_response path optional for MVP (P1/P2).
ci-bot: test-run: chat-shape-integration #345 — 42 tests passed, 3 flaky (function-calls).
Aisha (PM): action items: Tom: timeline & infra workplan; Nadia: test/eval harness + edgecases list; Jules: SDK snippets + docs skeleton; Ethan: gather 3 EA customer contacts and migration stories. I'll draft launch criteria doc and share tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): noted. I'll post a short RFC with API examples later today.
Ethan (CSE): will ping customers and collect sample payloads.
Jules (DevEx): will mock SDK API in a gist and tag everyone.
Nadia (ML): adding example edgecases to the RFC thread.
Aisha (PM): thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for decisions. if no major objections by EOD Monday we'll freeze shape for engineering work.
